record.title: Microduck right thigh housing — the 'upper_leg_right' body of Pollen's MJCF: the left thigh mirrored in x (measured exact), 28 x 47.7 x 61 mm one-sided cup holding the hip-pitch and knee XL330s
record.why: cad/part.py composes part:microduck-upper-leg-left through the triad loader and reflects it in the yz plane; bin/cad builds one valid solid and ce-cad/bin/cad-refcheck grades it against Pollen's own published mesh reference/pollen-microduck-rl/assets/upper_leg_right.stl: p95 surface distance 0.20 mm both ways (mean 0.036 / 0.031, median 0.002), bbox delta [-0.0, 0.001, -0.006] mm, 6/6 holes and bosses matched, 0 unmatched. Round 1 of 1 (out/refcheck/microduck-upper-leg-right/r1). The mirror relation itself was measured first: all 6123 welded vertices of upper_leg_right.stl coincide with x-negated upper_leg_left.stl at 0.0000 mm, both ways.
record.origin_why: the left thigh (itself modelled from Pollen's decimated visual mesh, CC BY-SA-NC) reflected in x, because Pollen's two meshes are exact mirrors and a second hand-typed copy of two hundred measured numbers would only drift. Nobody has Pollen's CAD; no physical part measured. Admitted through the TRIAD.md door: evidence/ledger.jsonl + computed trust.json.
record.why_this_folder_exists: The right thigh is a different print from the left (a mirrored cup: the single side wall stays on -y, the open face is at x = -42.5), so it needs its own folder, its own evidence and its own trust — but not its own geometry source. refs.json names part:microduck-upper-leg-left as the composition edge.
